scripts.lint: npm run lint -w order-api-nest && npm run lint -w order-console-next
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w order-api-nest -- tsc --noEmit && cd order-console-next && npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:api: npm run test -w order-api-nest && npm run test:e2e -w order-api-nest
scripts.test:rules: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/monitoring:/m" --entrypoint promtool prom/prometheus:latest test rules /m/alert-rules.test.yml
